raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-17 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. v2 evening transactions land at 00:00-06:00 on the next UTC date, so they fall on 2026-01-19 and are missing from 2026-01-18. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time in silver_transactions fixes the dates and the downstream gold tables.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
